12. Kirchhoff’s Rules –
(a) Junction Rule: At any junction of circuit elements, the sum of currents entering the junction must equal the sum of currents leaving it.
(b) Loop Rule: The algebraic sum of changes in potential around any closed loop must be zero.

The summary box is emitted as three blocks because a displayed fraction equation (R1/R2 = R3/R4) sits between its two prose stretches; blocks 1 and 3 are the two prose parts of that single box. The large five-column table (Physical Quantity / Symbol / Dimensions / Unit / Remark) is marked needs_special rather than transcribed, as its text layer is heavily scrambled below word level (exponents and subscripts on separate lines) and several Greek symbols are extracted as Latin look-alikes (rho as "r", sigma as "s", tau as "t", mu as "m", epsilon as "e"), and Ω as "W". The POINTS TO PONDER box begins at the bottom of the page with only item 1, which is why last_block_continues_on_next is true even though its final sentence is complete. Inline mathematics in prose keeps the characters the text_layer holds (e.g. "DS" for Delta-S) rather than being re-rendered.
